hook.line: Just 14 years after its release, two researchers independently proved that the first player wins by starting in the middle.
hook.say: Let’s drop into the history of Connect Four!

ch.say: It came from an American toy company.
p: In 1974 the American company Milton Bradley released “Connect Four”.
A vertical four-in-a-row where gravity drops the pieces, it became a hit with children and adults everywhere.
